summary: P1 Applicant Review Screen - All features tested and working. Backend API returns enriched applicant data with match_score, must_haves_met, career_stability, current_salary, notice_period. Frontend displays job info header, stage tabs with counts, applicant cards with all required fields, and detail dialog with 5 action buttons (Shortlist, Reject, Hold, Over Budget, Not Qualified). All roles (Admin, Employer, Recruiter) can access the applicants page.

✅ Applicants include must_haves_met array with {requirement, met} objects
✅ Applicants include career_stability with score (green/yellow/red) and quick_changes
✅ Stage counts include all 9 stages (applied, shortlisted, interview, offered, hired, rejected, on_hold, over_budget, not_qualified)
✅ Job info header displays job title, location, type, salary range
✅ Stage tabs show counts for each stage
✅ Applicant cards show: name, headline, match score badge, experience, location, must-have indicators

✅ 5 Action buttons work: Shortlist, Reject, Hold, Over Budget, Not Qualified
✅ View Applicants button on EmployerJobsPage navigates to applicants
✅ View Applicants button on RecruiterJobsPage navigates to applicants
✅ Career stability indicator shows green/yellow/red dot based on job changes
